label: MPR121 Capacitive Touch
info: Polls an MPR121 capacitive touch controller every 100 ms and converts the 12-bit touched bitmask into a human-readable string like 'ELE0 ELE3 ELE7 touched'. A Debug node displays the string. When no electrodes are touched, the function outputs 'none'. Touching multiple electrodes simultaneously is supported (multi-touch bitmask reads). This demonstrates polling-based multi-electrode touch detection on the MPR121.

name: format touched
